name: Flying Posters
rationale: Clean-room implementation from the one-line effect description only; no upstream source was read, and the WebGL (ogl) original is replaced by native scrolling plus CSS 3D transforms driven by custom properties, so it ships with no dependency.

speed.description: Autoplay drift, in px per second; 0 turns autoplay off.

tilt.description: Peak tilt of a poster at the viewport edge, in degrees.

depth.description: How far a poster at the edge sinks back, in px.

bend.description: Extra bend from scroll velocity, in degrees.

loop.description: Wrap the list seamlessly through one hidden copy of the posters.

pauseOnHover.description: Pause autoplay while the pointer or focus is inside the gallery.

a11y: The gallery is a native scroll container, so wheel, touch, scrollbar and keyboard scrolling (with tabindex="0" on the host) all work unchanged.
Loop copies of the posters are aria-hidden and inert, so screen readers and the Tab order meet each poster exactly once.
Autoplay pauses while the pointer or keyboard focus is inside the gallery and for a moment after any wheel or touch scroll.
Reduced motion removes the copies, the autoplay and every transform: the posters become a plain, flat scrolling list.
